description: A message can make the agent use the bash tool. "The reply R" is the first element matching '.messages-container [data-testid="message"]:not(.message-user)' whose text contains R (has_text): a message of this conversation that is not the user's. "The user message U" is the first '.messages-container .message-user' element whose text contains U (has_text). "The input" is the element with data-testid "message-input" and "the send button" the one with data-testid "send-button". "Send M" means: fill the input with M, then click the send button. 1. Navigate to /new. 2. Send 'bash: echo "hello world"'. 3. The reply 'I'll run the command: echo "hello world"' should be visible (allow 30s). 4. The first element with data-testid "tool-call-completed" should be visible (allow 10s). 5. The first element whose own text contains "bash" (selector "*" with has_text "bash", which picks the innermost) should be visible: the tool's name.

steps.has_text: I'll run the command: echo "hello world"
